title: GUI-PRA: Process Reward Agent for GUI Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2509.23263v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-horizon GUI automation remains challenging due to error accumulation over extended interaction sequences. Process Reward Models (PRMs) provide dense step-level supervision for mitigating error accumulation, yet standard PRMs are poorly suited to GUI verification. Standard PRM judgments often rely on superficial visual alignment rather than functional correctness, reflecting an evaluative knowledge gap caused by missing domain-specific adjudication logic. Standard PRMs also perform passive, single-pass visual assessment, which creates Visual Ambiguity when reliable judgment requires actively locating, parsing, or inspecting task-relevant UI evidence. We introduce GUI-PRA, a Process Reward Agent that transforms GUI process evaluation from passive scoring into active investigation. GUI-PRA couples Experience-Injected Criterion Synthesis, which distills generalized verification principles into state-specific criteria, with Criterion

translated_title: GUI-PRA：面向GUI任务的过程奖励智能体
translated_abstract: 长时程GUI自动化由于在长交互序列中的误差累积而仍然具有挑战性。过程奖励模型（PRM）通过提供密集的步骤级监督来缓解误差累积，然而标准PRM并不适合GUI验证。标准PRM的判断往往依赖于表层的视觉对齐而非功能正确性，这反映了由于缺乏领域特定裁定逻辑而导致的评估知识差距。标准PRM还执行被动的、单次视觉评估，当可靠的判断需要主动定位、解析或检查与任务相关的UI证据时，这会造成视觉歧义。我们提出了GUI-PRA，一个将GUI过程评估从被动评分转变为主动调查的过程奖励智能体。GUI-PRA将经验注入的准则合成（将通用验证原则提炼为状态特定准则）与准则……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GUI-PRA是一个过程奖励智能体，通过经验注入的准则合成，将GUI过程评估从被动评分转变为主动调查，从而解决长时程GUI自动化中的误差累积问题。
en_tdlr: GUI-PRA is a Process Reward Agent that transforms GUI process evaluation from passive scoring into active investigation, addressing error accumulation in long-horizon GUI automation through Experience-Injected Criterion Synthesis.
